name: AutoBattler
description: Movement-only autopilot for Brotato (MIT fork of BOTato, tested on 1.2.0.1). Auto-moves/dodges/collects during waves; every decision stays manual. Behaviour priors are inferred from measured build traits (no per-character table needed). v2.5.0: planning layer — pre-emptive breakout from a closing encirclement (future-freedom rollout + committed escape), committed high-value item goals (DLC evolution fruits, hurt fruit, trees) with a walk-on pickup fix and end-of-wave urgency; pursuit-aware second ply. All new behaviour has exact opt-out flags. v2.4.0: DLC-aware engage stances for cursed/evolved enemies + evolution item pickup. v2.3.0: ranged standoff, trees/hurt fruit, 2-ply planner + hit-adaptive caution. Toggle with Shift+Space.
